data.animaCaption: Seated at a grand piano with open orchestral scores on the stand, she pauses with a pen in hand and looks toward the viewer in the warm afternoon window light.

data.promptProse: At a polished black grand piano in a sunlit chamber rehearsal hall, Phrolova wears a pleated ivory Victorian blouse and crimson brocade skirt, annotating handwritten orchestral scores.
